buyer_province_code: two-letter abbreviation of the buyer's province
supplier_region: region where the supplier is located
agreement: name of the framework agreement the orders were placed under
good_service: whether the line concerns goods or services, as printed in the source
record_type: 'master' for an aggregated order record, which carries the CPV code NA; 'detail' for a line with a real CPV code or ND, which carries only an amount
order_count: number of orders; filled on master records only, empty on detail records
ordered_amount_eur: ordered amount in euro (the source writes decimals with a comma); filled on detail records only, empty on master records
buyer_count: number of buying administrations; master records only
supplier_count: number of suppliers; master records only
ordering_point_count: number of ordering points; master records only
